description: Synthetic, committed, and network-free. One corpus asked the same questions through the built-in lexical adapter and through the qmd adapter with one retrieval layer added at a time (bm25, vector, hybrid, full), so a metric that moves can be attributed to the layer that moved it rather than to one opaque pipeline. qmd's output is replayed from recordings of the real CLI: its query expansion is a language model, and its models are about 2GB that a CI machine has no business downloading. The prose and queries are inventions.

baseline.note: Layer attribution, not a regression guard for ranking constants. Measured on 2026-07-29, qmd 2.5.3: the lexical adapter and qmd's bm25 mode both ABSTAIN on the paraphrase question, whose words appear nowhere in the document that answers it — that is the gap the plan called unmeasurable, and it is now measured. vector answers it at nDCG@10 1.0000 and MRR@10 1.0000. hybrid and full answer it at nDCG@10 0.3869 and MRR@10 0.2000, with the right document ranked LAST of five. That last number is the finding, and it is not a defect in the qmd adapter: relevance is a multiplicative factor in fusion, a pure paraphrase measures 0 under Recall's shared lexical definition, so every candidate in those two modes scores 0, the source's own ordering is discarded, and the tie-break decides. vector scores 1.0 only because qmd returned one result there. Making paraphrase aboutness comparable across sources is the work this pack exists to justify; until it lands, a rise in mode-hybrid or mode-full here is that work landing, not this pack drifting. Two things the pack deliberately does NOT assert. It does not assert the reranked modes' off-corpus behaviour — they return unrelated documents at scores a caller cannot tell apart from a real hit, which is recorded in the adapter's search-ranked conformance transcript; asserting today's false positive as expected would make an improvement read as a regression. And it judges rank rather than relevance numbers, because a paraphrase hit's relevance is 0 by that definition and rank is what can honestly be graded.
